digest.component_or_area: Core infrastructure: retry wrapper, eval runner, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry is declared but never read, and swallows caller-provided timeout_s intended for wrapped Jira client instead of forwarding it via **kwargs
run_eval(dirty=) parameter is declared but never read and creates false implication of eval-provenance switching capability

module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metrics are permanently unavailable (compute=_no_data_yet) with no data source implemented, yet their registered ids block future real implementations from registering cleanly
Latent registration trap: future real specs for module_size_trend or commit_cadence_trend ids will be silently skipped when registrar finds id already held by placeholder seed
test_trend_unavailable test pins stub metric in place and must be removed when seeds are deleted
